Who we serve

Reusable drinkware for weddings, events and mobile bar operators

A glass that breaks mid-reception is not a cost problem, it is a safety problem and a photograph you cannot retake. Moulded drinkware lets you set a matched table for 200 guests and pack it back into the van the same night.

Request a quoteBrowse the catalogue

What usually goes wrong

The five problems we hear most from this buyer type.

  • Breakage during setup, service and pack-down
  • Mismatched glasses across a long table
  • Quantity shortages when the guest count rises
  • Replacements that arrive a different colour or weight
  • Washing and re-packing time between events

Set the table once, in one silhouette

The cleanest event tables are built from one family of shapes in one finish. Our flute, coupe and stemless ranges let you set a champagne toast, a cocktail hour and a wine service in the same colour and rim profile, so the table photographs as a set rather than a collection of borrowed glasses.

Because we hold the tooling, replacements ordered next season match the ones you already own. That is what makes a matched table possible across three years of bookings, not just one.

Planned by the guest, ordered by the pallet

A practical starting point is 2.5 glasses per guest for a full-service reception with a champagne toast and a cocktail hour, split roughly half flutes and half all-purpose wine glasses, plus a 10% breakage and loss allowance. A 200-guest reception therefore lands near 500 pieces, which is a comfortable first order against our carton quantities.

If you want the arithmetic done for you, tell us the guest count, the service style and whether the bar is indoors or outdoors, and we will return a suggested split by shape and a carton count you can hand to a driver.

Made for how event stock is actually handled

Stemless shapes survive freight and tent setup far better than stemmed glass, and they weigh a fraction of what crystal does, which matters when you are loading a van twice a week. For stemmed service, moulded one-piece construction removes the stem joint — the point where glass drinkware fails first.

Every item in this range is reusable and washable. Tritan and PP versions tolerate a commercial dishwasher; PET versions are the economical route for single-event use where the pack-down has to be fast.

Send the item list, quantities, decoration and destination. We reply with pricing by volume tier, lead time and carton data.

Reusable drinkware for weddings, events and mobile bar operators — questions

How many glasses do I need for a 200-guest wedding?

Plan on roughly 2.5 glasses per guest when the reception includes a champagne toast and a cocktail hour — about 500 pieces for 200 guests, split between flutes and all-purpose wine glasses, plus about 10% for breakage and loss.

Are these glasses strong enough for a poolside or outdoor bar?

Yes. Moulded Tritan, PET, PS and PP glasses are the standard solution for pool decks, beaches and terraces where glass is banned. Tritan is the most durable option and the one best suited to repeated commercial washing.

Can we get a matched set in our own colour?

Yes. Colour matching to Pantone is available and we issue a chip or sample for approval before production, so the colour is consistent across the whole order.

Can you deliver in time for a fixed event date?

FOB dispatch is confirmed per SKU — 10–15 days for a no-stock small batch, 15–25 days at 1,000 pcs and above, and 45–60 working days for no-stock electrical products. These are dispatch times only, not transit or delivery-to-door times. Tell us your event date at quotation stage and we will confirm what is achievable in writing.

Do you offer printed or engraved customisation for weddings?

Yes. Couple names, monograms, dates and venue logos can be pad printed or laser engraved. The minimum for each decoration method is confirmed per SKU and per decoration method in the quotation.

How do we plan the quantity against a guest list?

Quantity planning depends on the serve, the number of guests and whether the glass doubles as a keepsake. Send the guest count, the number of drinks per guest and the destination so we can confirm the case-pack quantity that covers the event.

Glasses per guest guide

Can the order be split across venues or dates?

Split delivery is assessed against the packing configuration and the destination. Send the delivery points and the dates with the item list so the packing and the freight are quoted for the actual route.
